#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

long long int mod_pow(long long base, long long exp){
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;
    long long result = 1;
    for(; exp > 0; exp--){
        result = (result * base) % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

int main(){
    long long base, exponent, result_power = 1;
    cin >> base >> exponent;
    if(exponent == 0){
        result_power = base - 1;
    } else if(exponent == 1){
        result_power = base;
    } else {
        long long temp = exponent;
        long long cycle_length = 1;
        while(temp != 1){
            temp = (temp * base) % base;
            cycle_length++;
        }
        result_power = (base - 1) / cycle_length;
    }
    cout << mod_pow(base, result_power) << endl;
    return 0;
}

long long compute_power(long long base, long long power){
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;
    long long res = 1;
    while(power > 0){
        res = (res * base) % MOD;
        --power;
    }
    return res;
}

int main(){
    long long p, k, pwr = 1;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if(k == 0){
        pwr = p - 1;
    } else if(k == 1){
        pwr = p;
    } else {
        long long x = k;
        long long count = 1;
        while(x != 1){
            x = (x * k) % p;
            count++;
        }
        pwr = (p - 1) / count;
    }
    cout << compute_power(p, pwr) << endl;
    return 0;
}
